purpose: Teach: 的中/村長/手抜き/投じ/成し遂げ/はかっ/事由/斡旋

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、仮説が的中する精度を統計で示せ
lines.en: Ren, show me statistically how accurately your hypothesis hits the mark.
lines.style: Firm level command, the name landing like a tap on the desk, zero wasted warmth.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。地方の村長への聞き取り調査を進めます
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll move ahead with interview surveys of the village mayors out in the regions.
lines.style: Quick eager reply, slightly breathless, audibly sitting up straighter as he answers.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、データ収集に手抜きするな
lines.en: Ren, don't cut corners on your data collection.
lines.style: Low warning weight on the prohibition, pace slowed so the words sink in.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究時間をたっぷり投じます
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll pour plenty of research time into it.
lines.style: Prompt and bright, a touch over-eager, nodding through the whole sentence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、博士論文を成し遂げた先輩を見習え
lines.en: Ren, learn from the seniors who actually saw their doctoral theses through.
lines.style: Measured mentoring push, steady deliberate pace, quiet expectation held underneath every word.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の使途をはかった上で申請します
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll weigh how the research funds will be used before I apply.
lines.style: Careful and precise, slowing over the procedural detail to prove he understands.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の引用事由を明確にしろ
lines.en: Ren, make the grounds for every citation in your paper explicit.
lines.style: Clipped final directive, each word placed deliberately, leaving no room for vagueness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会の発表枠の斡旋を依頼します
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll request a referral for a presentation slot at the conference.
lines.style: Composed closing reply, quiet resolve, a small exhale of relief at the end.
